pages.title: Gauge Boson Cluster
pages.text: Photon, gluon, W and Z: the particles that carry electromagnetism and the strong and weak forces. Each is the ripple of a symmetry in its field. The cluster is lively and restless in the hand, pushing and pulling in ways that do not quite add up to any single force.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Entangled photons gave me the photon; a glueball core gave me gluons; quark-gluon plasma at high energy supplied the W and Z. The Particle Spectrometer collected all four force carriers into a single cluster.
